meta.name: porch
meta.description: Protocol orchestrator CLI — drives SPIR, ASPIR, AIR, TICK, and BUGFIX protocols via a state machine. ALWAYS check this skill before running any `porch` command. Use when you need to check project status, approve gates, signal phase completion, or manage protocol state. Also use when a builder asks about gate approvals or phase transitions.

copy.tagline: 用状态机驱动项目协议流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中执行结构化协议并管理状态
copy.tagline_en: Drive project protocol flows with a state machine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to execute structured protocols and manage state in your project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 porch 命令管理开发协议流程：查看项目状态、标记阶段完成、检查门控、列出待批准项。门控批准需人工操作，Claude 不能自动执行。
howto.when: 当你询问项目状态、门控批准、阶段推进，或要求运行 porch 命令时触发。

say.note: 执行 porch status 命令。

say.text: 我完成了当前阶段，标记一下。
say.note: 执行 porch done 命令。

say.text: 列出所有待批准的门控。
say.note: 执行 porch pending 命令。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use porch commands to manage development protocol flow: check project status, signal phase completion, run checks, and list pending gates. Gate approvals require human action; Claude cannot auto-approve.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about project status, gate approvals, phase transitions, or request to run porch commands.

say_en.text: I finished the current phase, mark it done.
